_readme: EDITORIALLY MAINTAINED. This file is the only source for the two fields on
the masthead conditions strip that cannot be computed: the air temperature
and the sea/tide description. There is no weather feed, tide feed or API
wired into this repo, and nothing here is generated.
HOUSE RULE: never invent a value. If you have not checked the actual
conditions, leave the field null. A null field is dropped from the strip
entirely, which is correct: a short honest strip beats a full false one.
HOW TO UPDATE: set observedAt to the moment you actually checked (ISO 8601,
with the Melbourne offset), then fill temperatureC and/or sea. Anything
older than staleAfterHours is treated as unobserved and dropped, so a
forgotten file degrades to silence rather than to yesterday's weather.
NOT IN THIS FILE: sunset is computed from the date and the Peninsula's
coordinates in src/lib/sunset.ts, and the issue label is derived from the
current date in src/lib/edition.ts. Neither needs a human.
SHAPE: see _example below.
place         string  the point the readings refer to, e.g. 'Sorrento'
temperatureC  number  air temperature in whole degrees Celsius, or null
sea           string  short sensory read on bay and tide, or null
observedAt    string  ISO 8601 timestamp of the observation, or null
staleAfterHours number how long an observation stays publishable
